aiAudit.summary:
Summary advice (concise, evidence-backed). I do not change or comment on the official score — this is advisory only.

1) Top architecture risks (concrete observations + recommended mitigations)
- Cross-feature deep import detected
  - Observation: src/components/brand/brand-approved.tsx deep-imports dashboard internals (QUALITY deduction PK-QUALITY-063).
  - Risk: tight coupling, brittle interfaces, accidental breaking changes when dashboard internals change.
  - Recommendation: stop direct deep-imports. Add a dashboard public entry (index.ts) that exposes a narrow, versioned API or move the needed surface into a shared UI primitive under src/components/shared/ or src/components/ui/. Short-term: replace the import with a call to the dashboard public API. Priority: High.
- Unowned structural paths
  - Observation: 15 files under src/app/dev/brain/idea-lab and some API routes lack an owner (PK-QUALITY-004).
  - Risk: drift, unclear maintenance, regressions, incomplete CI/quality gating for those files.
  - Recommendation: assign owners for each path in ownership-rules.json (or create a dev/sandbox owner if intentional). If these are temporary/dev-only artifacts, move them under a clearly owned dev sandbox area and mark excluded where appropriate. Priority: High.
- Layer-mixing in server route
  - Observation: src/app/api/onboarding/workspace-context/route.ts mixes layers (db, server, next, engine) — PK-QUALITY-061.
  - Risk: responsibility creep, testability and deploy risk, se

improvementsNote: See git diff / session commits for completed work; this report does not invent progress.
